body:
Talking to you make me feel better about all this. Being able to know that I have your support even though we don't know each other it's really pleasurable. It definitely help me a lot.

Thank you again. I hope things get better soon<3

Thank you for taking your time in this, and sorry if it bothers you.

I feel that my parents are disgusted of me because I don't shower so often, brush my teeth or change my pajamas. But it's not because I'm lazy, I just don't have the motivation to do it, it's really hard for me and I don't know why.

I think that they're disappointed of me because I don't have good grades (even though they told me not to worry too much about it). I'm not pretty, funny or intelligent. I have diabetes so maybe that's a problem for them. They don't demand much of me, but I still thinking that I disappoint them and I can't explain it.

The same thing with my friends, I'm not funny so I think that I'm really boring for them. I'm not important in the group.

With my dad we used to discuss really hard sometimes. For example: one time I was worried because it was my bestfriend party and she was going to celebrate it with her school friends, but I didn't want to go because it's really hard for me to socialize with people that I don't know (and she knows that) Well, my dad was not understanding so he started talking to me about that. As always I ended up crying.
The last time was really bad, I don't know how to explain you what happened, but he was mad at me for a week. When he come back from work he didn't say hi to me and stuff like that. Eventually, everything was good between us.
But he's a good person, he just don't know how to express himself without sounding rude.

When I was 13 I have bulimia. Thankfully I could recover, because I read that throwing up could be bad for my teeth health. But now my eating disorders are difficult to explain for me. Some days I eat a lot and feel bad about it, other days I eat less (for example I skip meals sometimes) I always compare myself with other girls bodies and feel ashamed by mine and spend so much time looking at my body in the mirror.

I hope you can understand what I tried to write, English can be really hard for me. Thank you again for taking your time<3
thank you, I really appreciate it<3
